abstract: We describe a rare case of malignant teratoma involving the entire right lung. A 28 years old man was admitted to the hospital with severe respiratory failure and general malaise. Chest X-ray showed a dense opacity of the entire right lung, accompanied by pleural effusion. At autopsy, the right lung was completed replaced by a mass of variegated appearance combining cystic spaces and solid areas. Microscopically, the lung tumor exhibited a polymorphous histological picture. Most of the tissue had a malignant mesenchymal appearance, which included areas of chondrosarcoma, chondroblastic osteosarcoma, well differentiated liposarcoma, and undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma. Other areas of the tumor showed malignant epithelial components consistent with bronchial and urothelial mucosa with also scattered islands of pigmented epithelium of probable neuronal or retinal nature.
abstract_ja: 右肺全体を置換した悪性奇形腫の稀な症例を報告する。28歳の男性が、重篤な呼吸不全と全身倦怠感で入院した。胸部X線写真では右肺全体に濃い陰影と胸水を認めた。剖検時、右肺は嚢胞状の空隙と充実性領域が混在する多彩な外観の腫瘍により完全に置換されていた。組織学的には多形性の像を示した。腫瘍の大部分は悪性間葉系の形態を呈し、軟骨肉腫、軟骨芽細胞型骨肉腫、高分化脂肪肉腫、未分化多形肉腫の像を含んでいた。その他の領域では、気管支および尿路上皮の粘膜に一致する悪性上皮成分や、神経性あるいは網膜性と思われる色素上皮の散在性の島状構造が認められた。
